# eventclock

`eventclock` measures **event-clock time** (information time) ahead of
scheduled events — referendums, elections, central-bank decisions — from
traded event state prices such as prediction-market contracts.
Event-clock time \\A\_{t,T}\\ is the quadratic variation of the log-odds
of the state-price-implied event probability: how much outcome-relevant
information arrived, and when.

The package implements the estimators, closed-form calculators, and
datasets of the working paper

> Hanke, M., Schadner, W., Stöckl, S., and Weissensteiner, A. (2026).
> *Learning Before Scheduled Events: Prediction Markets, State Prices,
> and Option Valuation.* Working Paper.

A Python port is available at
[cgebe/eventclock-py](https://github.com/cgebe/eventclock-py).

## The workflow

The package implements the paper’s architecture end to end. The logic is
sequential: event-market prices supply the probability and the clock;
event-spanning options identify the asset’s outcome-conditional
distributions; options expiring *before* the event are deliberately left
out of the estimation, so that they remain available as an out-of-sample
test of the learning channel.

| Step | Object | Functions | Vignette |
|----|----|----|----|
| 1\. Standardize event prices | state-price-implied event probability \\q_t\\ | [`as_event_prices()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/as_event_prices.md), [`q_from_price()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_price.md), [`q_from_ffutures()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_ffutures.md), [`q_from_deal_spread()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_deal_spread.md), [`ec_validate()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_validate.md), `pm_*()` | [Brexit tour](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-brexit.html) |
| 2\. Measure the clock | \\A\_{t,T}\\ = log-odds quadratic variation, with robustness and inference | [`event_clock()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock.md), [`event_clock_path()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_path.md), [`ec_recovery_set()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_recovery_set.md) | [Brexit tour](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-brexit.html) |
| 2b. Measure it in practice | sampling frequency, real-time forecasts chosen without look-ahead, two venues | [`event_clock_staggered()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_staggered.md), [`ec_signature()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_signature.md), [`event_clock_forecast()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_forecast.md), [`ec_forecast_select()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_forecast_select.md), [`event_clock_venues()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_venues.md), [`ks_prices()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ks_prices.md) | [Measurement in practice](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-measurement.html) |
| 3\. Validate the estimator | Monte Carlo: consistency, CI coverage, jumps, microstructure | [`ec_simulate_path()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_simulate_path.md), [`ec_simulate()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_simulate.md) | [Validation](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-validation.html) |
| 4\. Exposure from returns | \\\widehat{\Delta\eta}\\ from \\r_t \approx \Delta\eta\\\Delta q_t\\ | [`event_beta()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_beta.md), [`ec_relevance()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_relevance.md) | [Event betas](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-event-betas.html) |
| 5\. Exposure from event-spanning options | log exposure \\\theta = \log(\eta_1/\eta_2)\\ via the lognormal event mixture | [`ec_mix_price()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price.md), [`ec_mix_iv()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price.md), [`ec_theta_fit()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_theta_fit.md), [`ec_theta_hump()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_theta_hump.md), [`ec_delta_to_k()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_delta_to_k.md) | [Event-spanning options](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-event-spanning.html) |
| 6\. Pre-resolution pricing and the learning test | held-out options vs. the no-learning benchmark | [`ec_mix_price_pre()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price_pre.md), [`ec_mix_iv_pre()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price_pre.md); first order: [`ec_sigma_eff()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_sigma_eff.md), [`ec_variance_share()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_variance_share.md), [`ec_iv_rule()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_iv_rule.md) | [Event-spanning options](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-event-spanning.html) |
| 6b. Ordinary smile for the test | template rules fixed in advance, chosen on earlier quiet surfaces | [`ec_quiet_library()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_library.md), [`ec_quiet_rules()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_rules.md), [`ec_quiet_select()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_select.md), [`ec_quiet_shape()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_shape.md) | [Event-spanning options](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-event-spanning.html) |

## Features

- **[`as_event_prices()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/as_event_prices.md)**
  — standardize any probability series (prediction markets, betting
  quotes, state prices) with flag-don’t-drop cleaning; converters
  [`q_from_price()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_price.md)
  (discount / overround),
  [`q_from_ffutures()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_ffutures.md)
  (fed funds futures, 25bp grid), and
  [`q_from_deal_spread()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_deal_spread.md)
  (merger-arb deal clocks); data screening with
  [`ec_validate()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_validate.md).
- **[`event_clock()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock.md)**
  — realized-variation estimator of \\A\\ with truncation, bipower, and
  largest-move robustness variants, plus standard errors and confidence
  intervals (`se = TRUE`, quarticity or wild bootstrap);
  **[`event_clock_path()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_path.md)**
  for the cumulative clock over time;
  **[`event_clock_forecast()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_forecast.md)**
  for the trailing-window real-time benchmark;
  **[`ec_signature()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_signature.md)**
  for the sampling-frequency (microstructure) diagnostic.
- **Assets & finance** —
  [`event_beta()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_beta.md):
  realized event exposures \\\widehat{\Delta\eta}\\ from returns with
  Newey-West errors and the \\\beta = 1\\ loading test against an
  external exposure;
  [`ec_relevance()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_relevance.md):
  the sufficient statistic for pricing relevance.
- **Event-spanning options** — the lognormal event mixture
  ([`ec_mix_price()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price.md),
  [`ec_mix_iv()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price.md));
  [`ec_theta_fit()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_theta_fit.md):
  the common conditional-mean-ratio surface fit for the log exposure
  \\\theta = \log(\eta_1/\eta_2)\\;
  [`ec_theta_hump()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_theta_hump.md):
  the first-order variance-hump estimator;
  [`ec_delta_to_k()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_delta_to_k.md)
  for standardized delta grids;
  [`ec_mix_price_pre()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price_pre.md)
  /
  [`ec_mix_iv_pre()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price_pre.md):
  exact pre-resolution option prices under event learning (the
  no-learning benchmark is the \\A = 0\\ special case).
- **Ordinary-risk benchmark** —
  [`ec_quiet_library()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_library.md),
  [`ec_quiet_rules()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_rules.md),
  [`ec_quiet_select()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_select.md),
  [`ec_quiet_shape()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_shape.md):
  the smile without event learning, built from earlier quiet-clock
  surfaces with a template rule chosen on pseudo-targets before the
  target.
- **Formula book** — closed-form calculators in \\(q, A)\\:
  [`ec_moments()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_moments.md),
  [`ec_exceedance()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_exceedance.md),
  [`ec_revision()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_revision.md),
  [`ec_atm_event_call()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_atm_event_call.md),
  [`ec_sigma_eff()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_sigma_eff.md),
  [`ec_variance_share()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_variance_share.md),
  [`ec_iv_rule()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_iv_rule.md),
  [`ec_target_clock()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_target_clock.md);
  exact transition law and simulators with lumpy-information jumps
  ([`ec_transition_density()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_transition_density.md),
  [`ec_simulate()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_simulate.md),
  [`ec_simulate_path()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_simulate_path.md)).
- **Measurement in practice** —
  [`event_clock_staggered()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_staggered.md)
  (staggered sampling grids),
  [`event_clock_forecast()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_forecast.md)
  with
  [`ec_forecast_select()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_forecast_select.md)
  (real-time forecasts whose window is chosen on earlier periods only),
  [`event_clock_venues()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_venues.md)
  (own, composite, and cross-venue clocks from two venues).
- **Connectors** — Polymarket:
  [`pm_search()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/pm_search.md),
  [`pm_markets()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/pm_markets.md),
  [`pm_prices()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/pm_prices.md),
  [`pm_daily()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/pm_daily.md)
  on the public Gamma/CLOB APIs; Kalshi:
  [`ks_events()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ks_markets.md),
  [`ks_markets()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ks_markets.md),
  [`ks_prices()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ks_prices.md)
  on the public trade API. Both keyless. Exchange options:
  [`cme_definitions()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/cme_definitions.md),
  [`cme_statistics()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/cme_statistics.md),
  [`cme_option_surfaces()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/cme_option_surfaces.md)
  turn CME Globex definitions and daily settlements (Databento
  `GLBX.MDP3` files you license yourself) into option surfaces.
- **Datasets** — `brexit2016`, `us2016` (the working paper’s event
  windows), `polymarket2024` (hourly 2024 U.S. election prices),
  `kalshi2024` (the same event on Kalshi, daily 15:45 snapshot),
  `djt2024` (the matching exposed stock), `us2016_surfaces_sim`
  (simulated event-spanning option surfaces), and `fomc_meetings`
  (2021-2027 FOMC calendar).
- **Plots** —
  [`plot_q()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/plot_q.md),
  [`plot_clock()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/plot_clock.md),
  [`plot_clock_vs_calendar()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/plot_clock_vs_calendar.md),
  [`plot_signature()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/plot_signature.md).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("sstoeckl/eventclock")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(eventclock)

ep <- as_event_prices(brexit2016,
  time = "date", price = "q_leave",
  market_id = "Brexit: Leave", event_date = as.Date("2016-06-23")
)

# the working paper's headline estimates
event_clock(ep,
  from = as.Date("2016-05-24"),
  to = c(`1W` = as.Date("2016-05-31"), `2W` = as.Date("2016-06-07"),
         `1M` = as.Date("2016-06-23"))
)
#> # A tibble: 15 × 10
#>    market_id     from       to         horizon n_obs n_incr n_gaps max_gap_days
#>    <chr>         <date>     <date>     <chr>   <int>  <int>  <int>        <dbl>
#>  1 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-05-31 1W          8      7      0            1
#>  2 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-05-31 1W          8      7      0            1
#>  3 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-05-31 1W          8      7      0            1
#>  4 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-05-31 1W          8      7      0            1
#>  5 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-05-31 1W          8      7      0            1
#>  6 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-07 2W         15     14      0            1
#>  7 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-07 2W         15     14      0            1
#>  8 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-07 2W         15     14      0            1
#>  9 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-07 2W         15     14      0            1
#> 10 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-07 2W         15     14      0            1
#> 11 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-23 1M         31     30      0            1
#> 12 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-23 1M         31     30      0            1
#> 13 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-23 1M         31     30      0            1
#> 14 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-23 1M         31     30      0            1
#> 15 Brexit: Leave 2016-05-24 2016-06-23 1M         31     30      0            1
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: method <chr>, A <dbl>
```

``` r

plot_clock(event_clock_path(ep, from = as.Date("2016-05-24")))
```

![](reference/figures/README-clockplot-1.png)

Live data from Polymarket:

``` r

mkts <- pm_markets("presidential-election-winner-2024")
tok <- mkts$token_id[grepl("Trump", mkts$question) & mkts$outcome == "Yes"]
ep24 <- pm_prices(tok, from = "2024-06-01", to = "2024-11-06")
event_clock(pm_daily(ep24))
```

(An alternative community client for the same APIs is
[polymarketR](https://github.com/clintmckenna/polymarketR).)

See the workflow table above for which vignette covers which step; the
full tour starts at
[`vignette("eventclock-brexit", package = "eventclock")`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/articles/eventclock-brexit.md).

## Citation

``` r

citation("eventclock")
```

Please cite the working paper above when you use the Event Clock
methodology, and for the identification theory (exact and partial
recovery, multiple venues) also the companion paper

> Hanke, M., Schadner, W., Stöckl, S., and Weissensteiner, A. (2026).
> *The Event Clock: What State Prices Identify About Physical
> Information.* Working Paper. [SSRN
> 7420838](https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=7420838).

# Package index

## Event prices

Standardize and screen traded event probabilities.

- [`as_event_prices()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/as_event_prices.md)
  [`print(`*`<event_prices>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/as_event_prices.md)
  [`summary(`*`<event_prices>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/as_event_prices.md)
  [`plot(`*`<event_prices>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/as_event_prices.md)
  :

  Standardize traded event state prices as an `event_prices` object

- [`q_from_price()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_price.md)
  : Convert event state prices into state-price-implied event
  probabilities

- [`q_from_ffutures()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_ffutures.md)
  : Meeting-implied probability from a fed funds futures price

- [`q_from_deal_spread()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/q_from_deal_spread.md)
  : Completion probability from a merger-arbitrage spread

- [`ec_validate()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_validate.md)
  [`print(`*`<ec_validation>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_validate.md)
  : Data-quality report for an event-probability series

## The event clock

Estimate information time A from log-odds variation.

- [`event_clock()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock.md)
  : Estimate event-clock time from log-odds variation
- [`event_clock_path()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_path.md)
  [`plot(`*`<event_clock_path>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_path.md)
  : Cumulative event-clock path
- [`ec_recovery_set()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_recovery_set.md)
  : Partial-recovery interval for the Event Clock
- [`ec_default_params()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_default_params.md)
  : Default parameters of the eventclock package

## Measuring the clock in practice

Sampling frequency, real-time forecasts, and multiple venues.

- [`event_clock_staggered()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_staggered.md)
  : Event Clock on staggered time grids
- [`ec_signature()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_signature.md)
  [`plot(`*`<ec_signature>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_signature.md)
  : Sampling-frequency signature of the Event Clock
- [`plot_signature()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/plot_signature.md)
  : Plot the sampling-frequency signature
- [`event_clock_forecast()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_forecast.md)
  : Real-time Event Clock forecast
- [`ec_forecast_rules()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_forecast_rules.md)
  : Candidate rules for real-time clock forecasts
- [`ec_forecast_select()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_forecast_select.md)
  [`print(`*`<ec_forecast_select>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_forecast_select.md)
  : Choose the real-time forecasting rule by out-of-sample accuracy
- [`event_clock_venues()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_venues.md)
  : Event Clocks from two venues: separating common news from venue
  noise
- [`event_clock_venues_path()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_venues_path.md)
  [`plot(`*`<event_clock_venues_path>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_clock_venues_path.md)
  : Cumulative Event Clocks from two venues

## Event-spanning options

The lognormal event mixture and the event exposure theta.

- [`ec_mix_price()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price.md)
  [`ec_mix_iv()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price.md)
  : Option prices and implied volatility under the event mixture
- [`ec_theta_fit()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_theta_fit.md)
  [`print(`*`<ec_theta_fit>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_theta_fit.md)
  : Estimate the log exposure theta from event-spanning option surfaces
- [`ec_theta_hump()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_theta_hump.md)
  : First-order log exposure from the spanning variance hump
- [`ec_delta_to_k()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_delta_to_k.md)
  : Convert a call-equivalent delta grid to log-moneyness
- [`ec_mix_price_pre()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price_pre.md)
  [`ec_mix_iv_pre()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_mix_price_pre.md)
  : Pre-resolution option prices under event learning

## Ordinary-risk benchmark

Smile shape of ordinary option risk from earlier quiet-clock surfaces,
with the template rule chosen on pseudo-targets before the target.

- [`ec_quiet_library()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_library.md)
  : Library of earlier option surfaces with their realized Event Clock
- [`ec_quiet_rules()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_rules.md)
  : Pre-specified rules for the ordinary-risk template
- [`ec_quiet_shape()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_shape.md)
  : Ordinary-risk template shape for a target
- [`ec_quiet_select()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_quiet_select.md)
  : Choose the ordinary-risk template rule on earlier pseudo-targets

## Exchange option data

CME Globex instrument definitions and daily settlements to option
surfaces with Black (1976) implied volatilities.

- [`cme_definitions()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/cme_definitions.md)
  : Read CME Globex instrument definitions
- [`cme_statistics()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/cme_statistics.md)
  : Daily settlement prices and open interest from CME Globex statistics
- [`cme_option_surfaces()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/cme_option_surfaces.md)
  : Option surfaces from CME Globex settlements

## Assets & finance

Event exposures and pricing relevance.

- [`event_beta()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_beta.md)
  [`print(`*`<event_beta>`*`)`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/event_beta.md)
  : Event beta: realized loading of asset returns on event-probability
  news
- [`ec_relevance()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_relevance.md)
  : Pricing relevance of event learning: the sufficient statistic

## Formula book

Closed-form calculators in (q, A).

- [`ec_moments()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_moments.md)
  : Moments of the terminal probability and log-odds
- [`ec_exceedance()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_exceedance.md)
  : Exceedance probability of the terminal event probability
- [`ec_revision()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_revision.md)
  : Typical revision of the event probability
- [`ec_atm_event_call()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_atm_event_call.md)
  : ATM claim on the event factor
- [`ec_sigma_eff()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_sigma_eff.md)
  : Effective volatility ahead of a scheduled event
- [`ec_variance_share()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_variance_share.md)
  : Variance share of event learning
- [`ec_iv_rule()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_iv_rule.md)
  : First-order implied-volatility contribution of event learning
- [`ec_target_clock()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_target_clock.md)
  : Event-clock time needed to reach near-certainty
- [`ec_logit()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_logit.md)
  [`ec_ilogit()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ec_logit.md)
  : Log-odds (logit) transform

## Prediction-market connectors

Public, keyless price histories from Polymarket and Kalshi.

- [`pm_daily()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/pm_daily.md)
  : Collapse intraday event prices to one daily snapshot
- [`pm_markets()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/pm_markets.md)
  : List the markets and outcome tokens of a Polymarket event
- [`pm_prices()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/pm_prices.md)
  : Download Polymarket price history for one outcome token
- [`pm_search()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/pm_search.md)
  : Search Polymarket events
- [`ks_markets()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ks_markets.md)
  [`ks_events()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ks_markets.md)
  : List the markets of a Kalshi event
- [`ks_prices()`](https://www.sebastianstoeckl.com/eventclock/reference/ks_prices.md)
  : Download Kalshi price history for one market
